Thank you, President. Our delegation wishes to express our concerns regarding the structure and processes of this annual session. As the session was heavily focused on essential matters of oversight, the decision to compress the agenda into 4 days despite objections predictably left insufficient time for both negotiations and plenary items, affecting the board's ability to exercise clear and thoughtful oversight. The traditional working methods of this board were repeatedly bypassed. Negotiations were rushed, held parallel to the plenary without announcement, preventing interested parties from participating and undermining the transparency essential for governance. While my delegation raised these issues repeatedly, they persisted unaddressed through the final moments. Furthermore, we regret that the insufficient time allotted to the plenary prevented member states and observers from making statements and asking questions directly to the agencies, effectively silencing the voices responsible for oversight. The United— the Executive Board sessions must be spaces for meaningful governance, not performative compliance. The United States strongly supports reform and efficiency and welcomes opportunities on how to improve the Board sessions thoughtfully and strategically. And while we appreciate that the session was ultimately extended to allow negotiations to conclude and the decision finalized, we call on the Bureau and the Secretariat to address these concerns for the next session. Thank you.
